title: The Vacuum Workout: Follow Along (3 Sets Of 20 Seconds)
hook: Do the stomach vacuum with me: three sets of 20 seconds.
body:
How to do it:
1. Set a 20 second timer.
2. Short breaths through your nose during the hold.
3. Deep belly breaths in the 30 second rest.
4. Do 3 sets, ideally first thing in the morning.
close: Beginner? Do one timed set in the mirror tomorrow morning.
youtube_description:
Follow along with me: three standing stomach vacuums, 20 seconds each, with 30 seconds of rest in between. I show you exactly how to breathe during a hold and between sets.

See what you'd look like with a six-pack, free:
https://absbyai.com/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=longform&utm_content=ro03-vacuum-workout

This is the workout-only companion to my full video, The Stomach Vacuum: The Best Ab Exercise For Belly Fat, where I explain why it works and why I recommend it. Watch that one for the explanation, then use this one to do the sets with me.

How to do the vacuum workout:
1. Stand in front of a mirror and set a 20 second timer on your phone.
2. Suck your stomach in and hold for 20 seconds.
3. During the hold, take short breaths through your nose. You will not be able to breathe deep, but you can keep breathing and keep talking.
4. Rest 30 seconds and take deep belly breaths to get your oxygen back.
5. Do three sets.

Best time: first thing in the morning, when you are fasted, even if you don't do intermittent fasting.

If you are a beginner: when you wake up, look in the mirror and do one timed 20 second set. Do that every morning.
